g.text: Name this computer; it becomes part of the default S3 prefix.
Choose a region and how credentials are obtained.
How should Sync Agent sign in to AWS?
Use the dedicated sync-agent profile. Credentials are not saved until final confirmation.
Pick the local folder and the S3 bucket/prefix it mirrors.
Absolute local sync folder (created if missing)
Press Enter to keep the safe defaults shown in parentheses.
Deletion propagation is OFF by default. Enable only after backing up and testing.
Propagate baseline-confirmed local deletions to S3?
New AWS access keys will be written to the sync-agent profile.
Save these settings? The current agent will stop.
Start requested. Sync Agent runs in the system tray (it may be under the ^ arrow).
Use --status and --logs to confirm runtime health.
